findings.evidence: `Basic.lean:111` defines `realOperator` by `S t.toNNReal`; `Basic.lean:99` gives native continuity at zero, `Basic.lean:408` gives continuity within `[0,∞)` at every nonnegative time, and the new lines `53`, `59`, `64` add strictly weaker special cases.
findings.fix: Prove `theorem continuous_realOperator_orbit (S) (x) : Continuous fun t : ℝ => S.realOperator t x` first, then derive `ContinuousOn (Set.Ici 0)`, `ContinuousAt` for arbitrary `t : ℝ`, and interval continuity without `ha hb`.
findings.issue: The three public wrappers stop at `ContinuousOn (Set.Ici 0)`, positive-time `ContinuousAt`, and nonnegative-endpoint `uIcc`, but `S.realOperator t x = S t.toNNReal x` is continuous also for `t ≤ 0` and at `0`; the natural API is global continuity of the real-time orbit.

summary: The orbit-continuity API is under-general: the real-time shim is continuous on all of `ℝ`, so the PR exposes only special cases with unnecessary positivity/nonnegativity assumptions.
